_: film3-motion: every input of the motion film. Swap the takes (and their moments) here when film3's final takes land; no code changes. Times in film seconds unless named *_at (a take second). Paths absolute or relative to the repo root.
_frame_width: a take's frame is shown this wide (screen px) at camera 1.0

paper._: M1 beat (a paper reads well: prose Korean, equations as typeset). M5: film3's equation take (Release 1d7e0ab, page 4 right column, display equation (6) kept, the prose below one Korean block). korean_at = the take second its lens cross-fade starts (measured on the take: 5.90 s; takes.json's 12.82 s is another clock), xfade_s how long it takes (to 6.12 s); crop = the take region (lens 770,340,600,530 pt + the page around it, above the Dock); equations = takes.json's equation_box_pt in the crop's px. For the placeholder (placeholder true) en/ko are the page and the app's render, crop the page region.
paper._hide: fragments the take kept in English (D3: the hyphen-split noth-ing), crop px, measured on the Korean frame: the hold keeps them under the caption pill (measure.py checks it)
paper._camera: glide keys [film second, x, y, zoom] in the crop's px: the point at the screen centre and the camera zoom. Wide for the cross-fade, up to the equation, then down to the hold (6.4 s on): the equation, its tag and the first two Korean lines whole (inline D(R)), lines from 104 px off the left; the third line, which keeps the hyphen fragment noth-ing in English (D3, paper.hide), sits under the caption pill (measured on the probe: the fragment's screen box inside the pill 96-745 x 859-996 from 6.4 s until the whip; 800/397.5 left its top 11 px above the pill)

before._crop: the take's region shown in the frame [x, y, w, h] (take px), or null for the whole take
before._spans: [span as read on the frame, the word to mark inside it]: each word gets a mark, and a margin note on its row

ui._: M4: the UI take (Release, AX only; takes.json "ui"): the lens menu, the Memory sheet, Customize, the Script row, the typing, the Run switch. Take seconds. window = the settings window's crop of the screen (take px); sheet (the Memory sheet: the panel shows it whole, then closes on the card), card (the Script section: header, editor, the Run row), editor (the code's area) and viewport (the sheet's scrolling area) in the window's / the card's px. Film times (menu.open/fade/click, moves, clicks) are seconds from timeline.fix_start; a move takes the window from one state to the next (fade = expand, scroll = a short slide). The Test step (182.5 s) is skipped (D12); typing is retimed to timeline.type_cps.

paper: Equations stay as they are; the sentences turn Korean
defect: Established terms come out as everyday words
fix: A few lines of script set it right
resolve: The same paragraph, the right terms

_ruby: M2: the replaced word written small above its new word in the resolution (take px of the after take); the lens opens line gaps for it
_marks: the marker bar under a word: bar_gap px under its ink, bar_h tall; prep thins and centres it where the next line is closer

timeline._: film seconds; after the typing everything is relative to the whip (= typing end + whip_after_type)

music._: film 2's bed (cut2-sources.draft2.json). start = the clip second at film 0: its beats fall on film x.0 / x.5: the toggle flips on the beat at 25.5 s, beat 64 (the drop, +10 dB) lands on the middle of the script -> paragraph whip (26.5 s = typing end 25.40 + 0.9 + 0.21), beat 31 (the groove) as the defect paragraph's Korean settles (10.0 s). First beat 0.2465 s, period 0.49999 s.
